For the reasons stated in the application, the delay of 17 days in filing the instant appeal is condoned 2.
Accordingly, the application is disposed of.

3. The present appeal under Sections 415(2) read with Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 assails judgment dated 11th September, 2025 and order on sentence dated 04th October, 2025 passed by Additional Sessions Judge (POCSO)-06, West District, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi in Sessions Case No. 308/2021 in FIR No. 141/2021 under Sections 363 & 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 read with Section 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act,
2012 registered at P.S. This is a digitally signed order.

CRL.M.(BAIL) 2565/2025 (seeks suspension of sentence)
7.
This application filed under Section 430 of BNSS seeks suspension of sentence of the Appellant during the pendency of the present appeal.
8. Issue notice.
Mr. Hitesh Vali, APP for the State, accepts notice.

9. Let status report be filed, with copy thereof provided to the opposite party.
10.
Issue notice to the Prosecutrix through the concerned SHO, returnable on the next date of hearing.

11. Let the latest Nominal Roll be also requisitioned from the concerned Jail Superintendent.
12. Copy of the order be sent to the concerned Jail Superintendent, for necessary information and compliance.
13. List on 20th March, 2026.
SANJEEV NARULA, J DECEMBER 24, 2025/ab
